name: GRX crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer average 710 g for the exact FC-RX810-2 reference with 170 mm arms and 48/31T chainrings; the 2020 table explicitly excludes the bottom bracket. Other arm lengths and ring options do not inherit this mass.
